newsitem.title: USA: Alliance Imaging to merge with Appollo unit.
newsitem.headline: Alliance Imaging to merge with Appollo unit.

text.p: Alliance Imaging Inc said Wednesday it has agreed to merge with Apollo Management affiliate Newport Investment in a deal worth about $258 million.
Under the merger agreement 95 percent of the fully diluted common stock of Alliance, excluding options and warrants to be cashed for their spread value, will be retired for $11.00 per share.

The deal is structured as a recapitalization, whereby after the transaction Newport would own about 82.2 percent of the common stock of the new company and existing shareholders would own the remaining 17.8 percent.

Upon the completion of the merger Apollo would be combined with SMT Health Services Inc, which is also being acquired by an Apollo affiliate. Apollo shareholders would own about 10 percent of the combined Alliance and SMT.

The Alliance acquisition is subject to shareholder approval and financing as well as normal closing conditions. A majority of Alliance shareholders have signed agreements with Newport to approve the merger.
